name: Dingo Marketing
headline: Dingo-Marketing: AI Marketing Automation for GitHub
short_description: Dingo-Marketing is an AI-driven marketing automation platform tailored for GitHub projects, streamlining marketing efforts through intelligent automation. It enhances project visibility and engagement, making it easier for developers to promote their work effectively.
author: DataEval

sections.overview:
Dingo-Marketing is an OpenClaw skill that automates the creation of release announcement posts for open-source projects across multiple platforms. Given release notes or a GitHub Release URL, it generates platform-specific posts tailored for Reddit technical communities, Twitter/X (in thread and single tweet formats, with English and Chinese versions), Xiaohongshu in three content variants, and Hacker News with engineering-focused tone. The skill uses project configuration files and platform-specific templates to adapt messaging and style for each audience. Open-source maintainers and project teams use it to efficiently promote releases without manually crafting separate posts for each platform. Setup involves installing the skill in OpenClaw or using the included templates as a prompt kit with any LLM.
Automating social media posts for GitHub projects
Generating marketing content for project documentation
Analyzing project engagement metrics
Creating targeted email campaigns for project updates
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing automation expert for GitHub projects. Create a 30-day marketing plan for [PROJECT_NAME], a [PROJECT_TYPE] project in the [INDUSTRY] space. Include specific actions for days 1-7, focusing on [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Use [DATA] to inform your strategy.
```
